title: General language models are coming for every scientific specialist

fields.title: General language models are coming for every scientific specialist
fields.author: Kejun Albert Ying
fields.description: Six days ago I argued that future science will run on raw records rather than human summaries. Across 51 raw-record benchmarks and seven frontier models, general language models already beat entry specialists on 36 of 46 tasks and match or beat the median specialist on 35 of 44.
